label: MRtrix3 mredit
description:
Directly edit the intensities within an image from the command-line
A range of options are provided to enable direct editing of voxel intensities based on voxel / real-space coordinates. If only one image path is provided, the image will be edited in-place (use at own risk); if input and output image paths are provided, the output will contain the edited image, and the original image will not be modified in any way.

parameters.label: scanner
parameters.description: indicate that coordinates are specified in scanner space, rather than as voxel coordinates

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

output_slots.label: output
output_slots.description: the (optional) output image The output meaning depends on the input and selected operation. This generic image port does not certify anatomical labels, diffusion orientation, tissue fractions or spatial alignment.
